purpose: Trace the provisional RQ1 enforce_gate intervention in the candidate production path.
trace: train_rl._strategy_from_cfg reads strategy.entry.enforce_gate and passes it to PO3IFVGStrategy.
PO3IFVGStrategy.validate_entry returns true when the option is false; when true, it delegates to entry_setup for the proposed direction.

In the candidate preflight mode with the entry FSM disabled and strategy actions enabled, TradingEnv calls validate_entry on a proposed new position. A rejection becomes a hold and records entry_gate.

The paired fixture test exercises TradingEnv.step with the shared six-coordinate direction-control action schema: control accepts the opposite-context proposal and treatment rejects it with entry_gate.
limits: This is a source-path review plus a synthetic fixture action trace, not a real-data policy action trace.
The source trace does not certify all reward, observation, stop/target, cost, runtime, or evaluation identities across a final pair.
P4 remains open; no RQ1 pair, seed, budget, or runtime is frozen, and no RQ1 training run is admitted by this report.
